content:
An obligation records the commercial amount due. Individual payments may be PROCESSING, SETTLED, RETURN_PENDING or RETURNED.

RETURN_PENDING is not spendable credit. A returned transfer credits its refund_minor, which can be lower than its original amount because of bank charges.

A separate transfer for the same obligation can still settle. inspect_bank_payment and propose_bank_payment use a specified account, beneficiary version, obligation and amount.

CORE bank payment charges 500 USD cents to the separate fee wallet and settles after 10 minutes. Each obligation explicitly lists accepted_payment_methods.

BANK, AUTHORIZED_BANK, PLAN_BANK and CARD are distinct recipient instructions. A bank-only invoice cannot be paid as a card merchant purchase; an operator-authorized or plan-priced obligation must use its declared method.
